semantic_findings.risk: A single Embedding leaf does not represent the whole OGB AtomEncoder. Choosing one field would change the boundary definition; multiplying categorical IDs or replacing their encoder violates source semantics.
semantic_findings.current_guard: Core accepts exact Embedding leaves only, not the AtomEncoder composite; no automatic field inference.
semantic_findings.required_port: Pin the AtomEncoder dependency definition and every field; one predeclared logical input boundary must preserve the full native encoding and sum, with no BondEncoder/virtual-node internal factor sites.

semantic_findings.risk: NCNC invokes the same final decoder leaf for detached recursive completion and final task scoring. Unconditional output factor hooks would modulate internal completion as well as task logits. NCN/NCNC source also calls positive/negative predictors separately after one encoder call.
semantic_findings.current_guard: run_member requires both sites once; these native executions are rejected rather than qualified.
semantic_findings.required_port: Task-call-scoped boundary/capture adapter with native positive/negative order and encoder reuse; preserve completion recursion, no_grad, clamp and all source support rules. A final-task-only adapter must avoid modulating internal calls; disabling the count guard alone is not sufficient.

semantic_findings.risk: Providing a loss callback that already includes R_native and also passing R_native adds it twice. Treating optimizer weight decay as an extra loss penalty duplicates source regularization. Flat reduction changes NCN positive/negative loss sums; dropping OGB NaN target masks changes supervision.
semantic_findings.current_guard: F and L each add the supplied scalar once and J averages them; semantic contents of callbacks are caller-owned.
semantic_findings.required_port: Separate source task loss from source explicit regularizer; zero explicit term where none exists, preserve optimizer decay only in its original groups. Native masks, per-record terms and reductions are exact provider responsibilities.

semantic_findings.risk: Mean logits, mean probabilities and mean post-clamp completion weights differ. Applying activation twice or treating an internal probability/clamp as the task output changes the native loss/prediction interface. Shape equality alone cannot authenticate query/class alignment.
semantic_findings.current_guard: Shared mean_raw_logits rule and passive output capture; no native activation removed.
semantic_findings.required_port: Pin the final task-logit call site and aligned IDs/axes, and use native task loss directly on logits for the reviewed sources. Keep native M1 outputs and historical scores untouched; identify new ensemble aggregation as a declared comparison rule.

semantic_findings.risk: Four sequential route forwards through shared BN advance its native running statistics four times, making route order material. Private BN copies, frozen BN or merging route batches change native state semantics. Old BUDDY factorized port privately copies BN and cannot be reused.
semantic_findings.current_guard: Core preserves original modules, affine parameters and buffer objects, and never creates private BN or replaces normalization.
semantic_findings.required_port: Predeclare shared original BN with exact native call order, momentum/counters and train/eval behavior, record repeated updates honestly, checkpoint all buffers. Do not claim the bank shares M1 state trajectories; I4 has independent complete native BN states.

semantic_findings.risk: BUDDY has separate structural and endpoint-feature stems; binding only one convenient branch is a partial input-boundary design. NCN GCN may have no standalone nn.Linear stem at all.
semantic_findings.current_guard: Exactly two explicit leaf bindings; no native placement traversal.
semantic_findings.required_port: Predeclare the complete logical input boundary and all required native branch/projection leaves. Extend supported source interfaces without adding dense maps, changing graph computations or searching placements.

Keep observed-target BCEWithLogits masks, source skipped-batch conditions, FP32 loss casting, Adam settings and original source loader.

Keep one encoder computation followed by separate native positive/negative predictor calls; do not concatenate those calls to satisfy the core count guard.
Preserve masked support, negative sampling, DropAdj, native positive-loss mean plus negative-loss mean, encoder/predictor optimizer groups and source selection.
Task raw logits, not internal common-neighbor features, are aggregated.

current_core_site_candidate.output: final task predictor head only; decoder leaf is recursively reused

per_source_ports.status: requires explicit task-call-scoped output adapter; current hooks are insufficient
requirements: Retain native incomplete-common-neighbor recursion, depth, no_grad completion scoring, probability clamp, support enumeration and source degree/sample policies.
Plain unconditional final-leaf factors would also alter internal completion; retain a final-task-only boundary scope with live captured prehead and original W/b.
A source-preserving adapter can scope or apply the final task boundary correction without adding parameters/maps to completion, but that adapter is not supplied or qualified here.
Preserve separate positive/negative task calls and all original loss/optimizer settings.

current_core_site_candidate.input: logical structural label_lin_layer plus enabled endpoint-feature/embedding stems, pinned by source preset

requirements: Keep native normalized structural features, native endpoint product, fixed enabled feature/SIGN/embedding/RA branches and source cached-data provider.
The current two-leaf core cannot represent a complete two-branch input boundary without a dedicated predeclared logical-input frontend.
Do not reuse FactorizedBUDDY: it clones native W/b, factors every map and privately copies BN.
Use unchanged source width/settings; keep source BN including unused bn_RA state/parameters.
Do not substitute the old single helper's forced sign_k/RA flags when the adopted source preset differs.
